blocks.text: Dennis Trillo and Jennylyn Mercado urged the public to stop the bashing and respect their respective families after Patrick Garcia spoke about his past relationship with the actress. Trillo took to his Instagram Story on Wednesday, Sept. 30, shortly after Garcia opened up about his past with Mercado in an interview with Ogie Diaz. “Hindi ako pabor sa bashing, pero salamat at naalala mo si Jazz dahil na bash ang anak mo. Spread Love not Hate [red heart emoji],” Trillo wrote. Mercado’s management agency, Aguila Entertainment, meanwhile, said the actress “will not comment or grant any interviews regarding Patrick Garcia’s statements […]...
